title: Quickly Roasted Carrot Quintessential Quesadilla
description: A tangy and flaky crowd-pleaser Canadian dish featuring red food coloring and a shojin-friendly glaze, perfect for snack time.

ingredients.name: Qwen's Gluten-Free Quesadilla Wrap (or any suitable tortilla)
Qwen's Gluten-Free Tortilla Filling Mix (or any suitable filling mix)

instructions: Combine shoyu sauce and red food coloring in a small bowl. Stir until fully dissolved.
Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Add vegetable oil and swirl to coat bottom evenly.
Distribute carrots, onions, and peppers on one half of the tortilla wrap. Pour glaze mixture over vegetables.
Fold tortilla wrap in half and place into the heated skillet for 2 minutes or until golden brown and crispy.
Carefully remove from heat and let cool slightly before serving to prevent burning fingers.
